_: Rung 1 of the fleet ladder on the MOBILE shell: friend request, accept,
DM both ways, between two iOS Simulators on the Mac mini.
Same journey as friend_dm.json, different surface. What differs on mobile
and cost a run each to find (2026-09-05): the Friends and Chats tabs carry
their badge in the semantics label ('Friends, 1 friend request'), which
the semantics: target now tolerates; a friend row's label is not itself
hit-testable, the row is, which the tap guard now accepts; the composer
is 'Type a message...' and sends with the Send button, never Enter; and
the Chats list only grows a row for a friend once a message exists, so a
opens the DM from Chats only after b has written.
${RUN} is unique per run and belongs in every message: the relay holds
undelivered traffic for three days and these identities are stable, so a
fixed string can be matched by an earlier run's message.
run (on the Mac mini): pwsh scripts/fleet.ps1 -Scenario mobile_friend_dm

steps.message: the accepted friend must reach the UI on BOTH sides, not just the friends table
one row per message in the open chat; the Chats list preview may add a second match, so the count is reported, not asserted

cleanup.message: nothing to undo: every run restores the fixture data directories, so the friendship and the DMs are gone before the next one starts.
